body_markdown:
***Darren Cook brings over 25 years of experience in transport planning, major scheme development and programme delivery, having worked on projects including the Lower Thames Crossing and Silvertown Tunnel***


**LONDON** (11 September, 2026) — AECOM, the trusted global infrastructure leader, has appointed Darren Cook as Highways & Streets Sector Director for its Europe and India region, strengthening its transportation leadership team and supporting the company’s continued growth across this market.


Darren joins AECOM from Arcadis, where he was Sector Director for Highways & Aviation in the UK & Ireland and a member of the UK & Ireland Mobility Executive Leadership Team. He brings more than 25 years of experience across the public and private sectors, including senior leadership positions with Arcadis and Jacobs, as well as earlier roles with Kent County Council and Sinclair Knight Merz.


Darren has worked across some of the UK’s most significant transportation programmes and infrastructure projects, including the Lower Thames Crossing and the Silvertown Tunnel. He has considerable experience developing strategic client relationships, having worked with national and regional government, local authorities, combined authorities, National Highways and Transport for London, among others, having led multidisciplinary teams across the UK, Europe and internationally.


**Steve Higham, Managing Director for Transportation, AECOM, said:** “Darren brings an exceptional combination of strategic insight, deep sector expertise and a strong track record of building trusted client relationships and high-performing teams. His experience working alongside government, the public sector and the wider transportation industry will be a valuable addition to our Transportation leadership team. As we continue to invest in our highways and streets capabilities and pursue opportunities that support more connected, resilient and sustainable communities, Darren’s collaborative approach and industry relationships will be a significant asset to our clients and our people.”


**Darren Cook, Highways & Streets Sector Director, AECOM, said:** “I’m delighted to be joining AECOM at such an exciting time for the transportation sector. Highways and streets are fundamental to how our communities connect, grow and thrive, and there is a significant opportunity to bring together the expertise of our people, our clients and our delivery partners to address the challenges and opportunities facing the sector. I look forward to working with colleagues across AECOM to develop lasting partnerships, create opportunities for our people to develop, and deliver outstanding outcomes for clients and communities.”


Darren is a Fellow of the Chartered Institution of Highways & Transport and a Fellow of the Royal Geographical Society. He is also a member of the UK Highway Sector Council and has held a number of industry-facing roles focused on sector leadership, professional development and future workforce capability.


*Darren Cook, Highways & Streets Sector Director, Europe & India, AECOM*
